correctness.rationale: Starting from the published system \(A(1+B)^k=B(1+A)^k=\Lambda\), the ratio coordinate \(r=(A/B)^{1/k}=(1+A)/(1+B)\) yields \(A=r^{k-1}/S_{k-1}(r)\) and \(B=1/(rS_{k-1}(r))\) by reversible algebra. Substitution gives the activity formula. Direct finite-sum coefficient collection gives \(rS_kS_{k-1}\,d(\log\Lambda)/dr=(r-1)Q_k\) with the stated strictly positive coefficients, proving global monotonicity. The hyperbolic form of \(S_m(e^s)\) gives the quadratic activity expansion and the sharp order-parameter amplitude. Exact rational and polynomial replay checks corroborate, but do not replace, these analytic steps.
